errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Reload the page.
errors.not_found: This call doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
errors.forbidden: Only the person who recorded the call or an admin can do that.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.invalid_meeting_url: Paste a Google Meet link, like https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij.
errors.unsupported_platform: The bot joins Google Meet for now. Zoom and Teams are on the way.
errors.bot_not_configured: The recording bot isn't set up on this server. An admin can set CALLS_BOT_URL and CALLS_BOT_SECRET.
errors.bot_unreachable: The recording bot didn't answer. It will try again in a minute.
errors.bot_busy: The recording bot was busy with other meetings and couldn't join in time.
errors.bot_rejected: The recording bot refused the meeting link.
errors.callback_not_allowed: The recording bot can't send recordings to this server. An admin needs to add its address to the bot.
errors.at_capacity: The recording bot was busy with other meetings.
errors.lobby_timeout: Nobody let the bot in. In Meet, admit "zerosoft Notetaker" when it asks to join.
errors.denied: Someone in the meeting declined the bot.
errors.invalid_meeting: The meeting link doesn't work. Check that the meeting exists.
errors.join_error: The bot couldn't join the meeting.
errors.record_error: The bot joined but couldn't record.
errors.bot_lost: We lost contact with the bot during the meeting.
errors.storage_unavailable: There's nowhere to store recordings on this server. An admin needs to set up file storage.
errors.unsupported_file: Upload an audio or video file (MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4, WebM or MOV).
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large. The limit is 2 GB.
errors.not_uploading: This upload already finished or was cancelled.
errors.invalid_part: A piece of the file didn't upload. Try again.
errors.not_live: The bot isn't in this meeting anymore.
errors.ai_disabled: AI isn't set up on this server, so there's no summary or analysis.
errors.quota_exceeded: Your workspace used its AI quota for this month.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.empty_transcript: There's no transcript to work with.
errors.no_speech: Nobody spoke in the recording, so there's no transcript.
errors.analysis_failed: The transcript is ready but the analysis failed. Try "Analyze again" in Insights.
errors.channel_not_member: Join that Talk channel first: the summaries are posted where you are a member.
errors.deal_not_found: That deal doesn't exist or you can't see it.
errors.event_not_found: That meeting is no longer in your calendar.
errors.invalid_clip: The clip needs a name and an end after its start (at least one second).
errors.too_many_clips: A call can have up to 100 clips.
errors.too_many_live: The bot is already in too many of your team's meetings. Stop one or wait for it to end.
errors.consent_not_sent: The bot couldn't post the recording notice in the meeting chat, so it didn't record.

library.title: Calls
library.desc: Every recorded sales call with its transcript, summary and what moved the deal.
library.search: Search titles and what was said
library.emptyBody: Send the notetaker to a Google Meet, let it join your calendar meetings, or upload a recording.

new.title: New call
new.botMissing: The recording bot isn't set up on this server yet. You can still upload a recording.
new.meetHelp: The notetaker asks to join, posts a recording notice in the meeting chat and leaves when the meeting ends. Someone has to let it in.
new.uploadHelp: Audio or video up to 2 GB. Files up to 24 MB are transcribed; larger ones are kept with the recording only.

call.stopped: The bot is leaving the meeting
call.stopBody: The bot leaves the meeting now. What it recorded so far is saved and transcribed.
call.deleteBody: The recording, transcript, comments and clips are deleted. This can't be undone.

liveBody.queued: The bot is on its way to the meeting.
liveBody.joining: The bot is opening the meeting.
liveBody.waiting: In Meet, let in "zerosoft Notetaker". It waits up to 10 minutes.
liveBody.recording: The bot is in the meeting and recording. It leaves when the meeting ends.
liveBody.uploading: The meeting ended. The bot is saving the recording.
liveBody.processing: Transcribing and analyzing. This takes a minute or two.

call.noRecording: There's no recording for this call.
call.noTranscript: There's no transcript for this call.
call.transcriptLater: The transcript appears here when the recording is processed.
call.noNextSteps: No next step was agreed in this call.
call.noAnalysis: There's no AI analysis for this call.
call.analysisLater: The analysis appears here when the recording is processed.
call.dealLinked: Deal linked. The call is logged on it.
call.crmLogged: Logged as a meeting in the CRM.
call.noSides: Mark each speaker as our team or customer to see the talk ratio.
call.commentsEmpty: No comments yet. Comment on a moment from the transcript.
call.clipHelp: Times as m:ss. Clips are shared with people in your workspace.
call.clipsEmpty: No clips yet. Pick a moment in the transcript and choose Clip.
call.askLater: You can ask questions once the call is transcribed.
call.askPlaceholder: What did they say about pricing?
call.sharePublic: Anyone with the link can watch
call.sharePublicHelp: Shows the recording, transcript, summary and next steps. Comments, scorecard and the deal stay private. Turn it off to stop the link.

help.spiced: Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event and Decision.
help.meddic: Metrics, Economic buyer, Decision criteria, Decision process, Identify pain and Champion.
help.custom: Write one criterion per line. Each call is scored on them.

rules.external: Meetings with people outside your team

deals.title: Deals
deals.desc: Open deals with recorded calls, and the signals that put them at risk.
deals.noCrm: Deals come from the CRM. Ask an admin for access to it.
deals.emptyBody: Calls are linked to a deal by the email of the people in the meeting, or by hand from the call.

ask.title: Ask your calls
ask.desc: Questions about every call you can see. The answer says which calls it comes from.
ask.placeholder: What objections came up about pricing this month?
ask.noCalls: Once you have recorded calls, you can ask about them here.

examples.b: What do customers say about pricing?
examples.c: Which calls ended without a next step?

settings.title: Calls settings
settings.desc: Your recording rule, and how calls are analyzed and shared in the workspace.
settings.botOk: The recording bot is set up.
settings.botMissing: The recording bot isn't set up on this server. Uploads still work.
settings.storageMissing: There's no file storage for recordings on this server.
settings.calendarHelp: Meetings come from the calendar you connect in Cal.
settings.personalDesc: Which of your calendar meetings the notetaker joins.
settings.workspaceDesc: These settings apply to everyone in the workspace.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.competitorsHelp: Separated by commas. Every mention is marked in the call, on top of the ones the AI finds.
settings.visibilityTeam: Everyone with Calls in the workspace
settings.visibilityPrivate: Only the person who recorded and admins
settings.botName: Bot name in the meeting (always ends in Notetaker)
settings.consentPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default notice in the language of the person who records.
settings.consentHelp: The bot posts it in the meeting chat when it joins, and again when someone new joins. A sentence saying the call is recorded is always added.
settings.logToCrm: Log each call as a meeting on its deal and contact in the CRM
settings.talkChannel: Post summaries to a Talk channel
settings.talkHelp: Each ready call posts its summary and next steps. You need to be a member of the channel. Not used when calls are private.
settings.webhooksHelp: To send calls to another tool, subscribe a webhook to "Call recorded and analyzed".
settings.costEconomyHelp: About US$0.13 per recorded hour: fast transcription and a smaller model for the summary and scorecard. Good for most calls.
settings.costPremiumHelp: About US$0.50 per recorded hour: the suite's transcription and its main AI model. More precise summaries and scorecards.

analytics.title: Calls analytics
analytics.desc: Recorded calls and minutes, how much your team talks, what comes up and how each rep does.
analytics.privateScope: The workspace keeps calls private: these numbers count only your calls.
analytics.noCompetitors: No competitors came up in this period.
analytics.noTalk: No calls with speakers in this period.
analytics.emptyTitle: No recorded calls in this period
analytics.emptyBody: Send the bot to a meeting or upload a recording and the numbers show up here.
